_comment: M2: crop rows 80:182 of the 320x240 render, resized to 160x80 (WxH). Bottom bound moved from 240 to 182 (was: crop rows 80:240) because rows ~182-239 render as skybox, not ground, in every sample -- MuJoCo's near-clipping plane, not an insufficient ground plane or the vehicle's own geometry (see docs/decisions.md ADR-12: extent(18.51) x default map.znear(0.01) = frustum_near(0.185m), verified against the measured artifact row to within 1 pixel via ray-casting, with a reflectance=0 control ruling out a lighting explanation). ADR-12 also covers why the MJCF itself is NOT fixed here (deferred to the v1 track re-render) and what the real fix looks like (explicit small <visual><map znear=.../></visual> or <statistic extent=.../>, not shrinking the floor). perception/model/preprocess.py and perception/model/lane_cnn.py read the resulting shape from here rather than hard-coding it. tools/visualize_camera_coverage.py and tools/camera_resolvability.py also read this file for their crop-rectangle overlay and CNN-resolution lane-width curve. docs/decisions.md ADR-11 finding 7 still applies: perception/dataset/camera_visibility.py's lane_is_visible/any_lane_visible run on the full 320x240 frame, not this crop.
